description: Daily installs by attribution source from Apptiller's attribution layer (Apptiller's own Apple AdServices lookup, AppsFlyer and Adjust when connected: their rows carry every metric the MMP reports in metrics, including sessions, revenue, cost and in-app events; Adjust also has ad group rows), by network, campaign, ad group, keyword or ad, between two dates, with claim type, conversion type and country counts. These are installs as the attribution source saw them, not what the ad network claims or what the revenue tool tagged.
name: attribution_performance
title: Attributed installs
